verdict.rationale: Mixpanel exposes APIs (Query, Raw Export, Engage, Feature Flags) and a hosted MCP server, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence describes service accounts, scoped tokens, role-limited keys, or least-privilege permissions for API or MCP access. The MCP server and API docs describe data access, not credential scoping, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
